title: The Road to Great Falls
subtitle: Motorcycle Touring Rally · June 11–27, 2027
summary: 17-day, approximately 4,500–4,900-mile round-trip group touring plan. Six northbound days, rally June 17–20, seven southbound days. Distances are estimates, not GPS-verified.

rally.description: Four days for the rally, fellow riders, activities and optional local rides. An optional early Sunday departure may allow additional Moab time.

guidelines: Informal group travel, not an officially sanctioned club ride. Each rider makes their own riding and safety decisions.
Designate a lead and sweeper; agree on fuel stops, regroup points and departure times each morning.
Use staggered formation where appropriate on open roads and single file with greater spacing on mountain curves.
Check high-elevation road conditions close to departure; Yellowstone travel may be slow.
Plan for late-June heat in New Mexico and Texas; never force a mileage target in unsafe conditions.
Navigation tracks and hotel stops will be confirmed later. Keep emergency contact and medical information private, outside this public site.

days.title: The Woodlands → Amarillo, TX
days.description: A purposeful first travel day via Fort Worth, Wichita Falls and US-287. Start early, make regular fuel and hydration stops, and settle in for the first overnight.

days.title: Amarillo → Colorado Springs, CO
days.description: Ride north via Raton Pass, Pueblo and the Front Range. A more relaxed transit day that positions us for the scenic Colorado roads.

days.title: Colorado Springs → Poudre Canyon → Cameron Pass → Walden → Laramie
days.description: Follow CO-14 along the Cache la Poudre River, climb Cameron Pass, then ride through North Park toward Wyoming.

days.title: Laramie → Snowy Range → Saratoga → Rawlins → Wind River Canyon → Thermopolis
days.description: Cross WY-130 through the Snowy Range, then continue north to Shoshoni and US-20 through Wind River Canyon. Allow time for alpine viewpoints and canyon photos.

days.title: Thermopolis → Cody → Chief Joseph Byway → Cooke City → Beartooth Highway → Red Lodge
days.description: WY-296 and US-212 deliver mountain curves, sweeping vistas and the Beartooth summit, weather permitting.

days.title: Red Lodge → White Sulphur Springs → Kings Hill Scenic Byway → Great Falls
days.description: Ride north toward the Little Belt Mountains and US-89 over Kings Hill. Arrive a day before the rally.

days.title: Great Falls → Livingston → Paradise Valley → Gardiner
days.description: Head south toward Yellowstone via scenic Paradise Valley. Overnight near the park’s north entrance for an early start.

days.title: Gardiner → Yellowstone National Park → Grand Teton → Jackson
days.description: A national-park day for wildlife, geothermal features and the Tetons. Expect slow speeds, traffic and frequent stops.
stops: Old Faithful, Yellowstone National Park, WY

days.title: Jackson → Pinedale → Rock Springs → Flaming Gorge → Vernal
days.description: Travel through western Wyoming and descend toward Utah on US-191, enjoying the Flaming Gorge landscape without a major detour.

days.title: Vernal → Moab → Grand Junction → Montrose
days.description: A taste of Moab’s red-rock country, then continue toward western Colorado. Extensive park visits are not included.

days.title: Montrose → Ouray → Silverton → Durango → Pagosa Springs → Santa Fe
days.description: Ride US-550’s Million Dollar Highway between Ouray and Silverton. Continue through Durango and Pagosa Springs before Santa Fe.

days.title: Santa Fe → Santa Rosa → Clovis → Lubbock → Abilene
days.description: Longest southbound transit day. Leave early to reduce afternoon heat exposure; plan breaks and adjust the overnight if needed.

days.title: Abilene → The Woodlands
days.description: Final ride home. Start early to avoid the hottest part of the day; finish at a comfortable pace.
